accepted_context_summaries.summary: The structured roadmap JSON is the active canonical seed, but multiple markdown roadmaps still read like active Go sources. Future agents must treat markdown as source material or rendered views, not authoritative mutable state.

The import candidate set already spans master, subagent runtime, orchestration, PlanGraph, AgentRun, ContextCapsule, thread bridge, quality gates, scaling, memory, RAPTOR, remaining features, GitHub, Telegram, Universal Inbox, and GameDev roadmap sources.

PlanGraph, OrchestrationRegistry, AgentRun, ContextCapsule, and SubagentRunSpec are usable as the first runtime projection layer, but the richer roadmap JSON remains necessary until PlanRuntime supports horizon, version, provenance, gates, blocked actions, and report-reduction metadata.

The next schema slice needs an import envelope, runtime projection, and reconciliation record with source path, roadmap spec version, import batch id, source hash/provenance, raw source node id, line or span, reconciliation decision, conflict status, and redaction marker.
